items.title: Compiler Design: solved PYQs (latest 3 papers)
items.body: Final 2025-26, Re-exam 2024-25 and Final 2023-24, every question solved. Read it on the site, search it, or download the PDF. Also in the Drive folder.

items.title: This notice board
items.body: Whatever gets added to the site is posted here, newest first. New ones are marked NEW until you have seen them.

items.title: Shared page links open the exact page
items.body: Use the reader's menu → Share this page. The link now lands on that page instead of the top of the document.

items.title: Operating Systems: Units 1–4 and Units 5–7 TEE decks
items.body: Both slide decks are readable on the site, with search and contents.

items.title: Exam timetable and countdown
items.body: The desk shows your next paper and how long is left. Tap it to see all papers and jump to a subject.

items.title: Download a whole subject
items.body: Every subject page has a button that bundles all its PDFs into one zip, for offline use.

items.title: Class material and PYQs on Drive
items.body: Each subject page now lists its Google Drive folders, so class material and previous-year papers are one tap away.
